one_line: Third Sultan of Delhi’s early Mamluk dynasty, a disciplined cavalry commander and empire-builder of the 13th century.

appearance.age_look: mid-40s, lean but strong, upright military posture
appearance.face: oval face with a neatly trimmed black beard and short moustache, wheatish North Indian complexion, sharp nose, intense narrow eyes with dark brows, default expression calm and calculating with a faint, reserved resolve
appearance.hair: straight black hair kept short to medium length, mostly hidden under a deep maroon quilted turban-wrapped cap with a slightly tapered crown and a simple gold band at the base, no plume
appearance.costume: layered Ghurid-era Sultanate attire: a long-sleeved, thigh-length quilted Qaba coat in deep indigo blue with subtle vertical stitching, worn over a light cream cotton tunic; a wide leather belt dyed dark brown with a simple bronze buckle; loose straight trousers in muted olive green tucked into mid-calf brown leather riding boots; over the Qaba, a sleeveless mail-lined Surcoat in rich maroon with sparse gold edging at the collar and armholes, reflecting a ruler who leads cavalry; minimal jewellery—a plain gold signet ring on his right hand and a narrow gold bracelet on his left wrist, no ostentatious finery
appearance.signature: a slightly curved Indo-Turkic cavalry sword with a plain steel blade, simple cross-guard and a dark brown leather-wrapped hilt, carried sheathed at his left hip and sometimes held in his right hand, scabbard in dark indigo with modest bronze fittings

ref_desc: Mid-40s Iltutmish with a wheatish oval face, short black hair under a maroon turban-cap, deep indigo quilted Qaba over cream tunic, maroon surcoat, olive trousers, brown boots, and a sheathed curved cavalry sword at his left hip in indigo and bronze tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Shams-ud-Din Iltutmish standing firmly, showing him in his canonical look: a mid-40s lean ruler with an oval wheatish face, neatly trimmed black beard and intense eyes, short black hair mostly hidden under a deep maroon quilted turban-wrapped cap with a simple gold band. He wears a long-sleeved, thigh-length quilted Qaba coat in deep indigo blue over a light cream cotton tunic, belted with a dark brown leather belt and bronze buckle, and loose olive green trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather riding boots. Over the Qaba is a sleeveless maroon surcoat with subtle gold edging at the collar and armholes, suggesting practical armour for a cavalry commander. Keep jewellery minimal: a plain gold ring on his right hand and a narrow gold bracelet on his left wrist. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon, a slightly curved Indo-Turkic cavalry sword with a plain steel blade, simple cross-guard, dark brown leather-wrapped hilt, and a dark indigo scabbard with modest bronze fittings; he may lightly rest his right hand on the hilt. Use a palette dominated by deep indigo blue, rich maroon, cream, olive green, and dark brown, with gold only as subtle trim, and keep the overall design era-accurate, dignified and fully clothed while stylised in dynamic shonen anime proportions.
